profile_text.body:
Twilio Inc is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker TWLO and CIK 0001447669. Its website describes a platform for customer engagement that offers APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, along with conversational AI and identity verification. The company describes the platform as built for the "agentic era," connecting communication channels, customer context, and AI on one flexible platform with pay-as-you-go pricing.

The site positions Twilio's AI as enabling humans and AI agents to work together across channels. It says AI agents draw from internal knowledge and real-time data, transfer conversations to humans with full context when needed, and coordinate so interactions feel continuous and personal. The company also describes tools for orchestrating context-rich conversations across channels.

California records list 281 law exposure entries for Twilio, and no specific cases are detailed. The company is also listed under the alias TWILIO INC - A.
